title: What Each Extended Equipment Warranty Plan Covers: Component and Service Comparison Sheet
content:
Comparison of the six Extended Equipment Warranty Plans by what each tier covers on an approved claim. "Covered" means the tier pays that item on a covered claim; "Not covered" means the tier does not pay it. The refrigerant, labor-rate and temporary-equipment lines carry a figure per tier.

## Covered components

| Item | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Parts Protection Plan | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Compressor Coverage Plan | Major Component Protection Plan | Total Equipment Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Replacement parts | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Labor to fit a covered part | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Compressor replacement | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Heat exchanger replacement | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered |
| Evaporator and condenser coil replacement | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Control boards and sensors | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Fan and blower motors | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Crane and rigging for a covered replacement | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Diagnostic call that finds the covered fault | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Covered repair performed outside regular hours, without premium | Not covered | Not covered | Not covered | Covered | Covered | Covered |
| Temporary equipment while a covered unit is down | Not included | Not included | Not included | Not included | Included | Included |

## Figures per tier

| Figure | Manufacturer Warranty Registration | Parts Protection Plan | Parts & Labor Protection Plan | Compressor Coverage Plan | Major Component Protection Plan | Total Equipment Protection Plan |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Refrigerant covered per claim | 0 lbs | 0 lbs | 10 lbs | 25 lbs | 40 lbs | 80 lbs |
| Rate billed for refrigerant beyond the covered pounds | 118 USD per lb | 112 USD per lb | 106 USD per lb | 102 USD per lb | 98 USD per lb | 94 USD per lb |
| Labor rate the plan pays for covered work | 0 USD per hour | 0 USD per hour | 132 USD per hour | 128 USD per hour | 124 USD per hour | 118 USD per hour |
| Daily charge for temporary equipment where it is not included | 385 USD per day | 385 USD per day | 365 USD per day | 345 USD per day | 0 USD per day | 0 USD per day |

## Line notes

- **Refrigerant.** The pounds shown are covered per claim; refrigerant beyond those pounds is billed at the tier's per-pound rate. On the two tiers that cover 0 lbs, every pound is billed at the rate shown (118 USD per lb on the Manufacturer Warranty Registration, 112 USD per lb on the Parts Protection Plan).
- **Labor rate.** The rate shown is what the plan pays per hour for covered work on the tiers that cover labor; the two tiers that do not cover labor show 0 USD per hour.
- **Temporary equipment.** Where temporary equipment is included (Major Component Protection Plan, Total Equipment Protection Plan) the daily charge is 0 USD; where it is not included the daily charge shown applies per day.
- **After-hours work.** On the Compressor Coverage Plan, the Major Component Protection Plan and the Total Equipment Protection Plan a covered repair performed outside regular hours is covered without premium; on the three lower tiers it is not.

## Hypothetical readings of the sheet

- A failed condenser coil on a unit held on the Parts Protection Plan: coil replacement is not covered at that tier, while the same coil on the Parts & Labor Protection Plan or any higher tier is covered.
- A compressor on the Parts & Labor Protection Plan: compressor replacement is not covered; on the Compressor Coverage Plan and above it is covered, and crane and rigging for that covered replacement are covered as well.
- Refrigerant of 30 lbs approved on a Compressor Coverage Plan claim: 25 lbs are covered and the 5 lbs beyond are billed at 102 USD per lb; the same 30 lbs on the Major Component Protection Plan fall entirely inside the 40 covered lbs.
